authenticatedAs: the operator's existing signed-in local Chrome session; no credential was entered, minted, stored or read by the audit
dataSource: real workspace payload from GET /api/meta/decisions-workspace (HTTP 200), real production data
measurementMethod: same-origin iframe sized to the exact viewport inside the signed-in tab; the signed-in Chrome tab itself cannot be resized (resize_window is a no-op on it), and the iframe keeps the session intact
screenshotCaptureMethod: independent post-correction capture from the operator's existing signed-in top-level Chrome tab at an exact 1440x900 browser viewport; the main Decision Center scroller was moved through the UI so both direction headers and canonical lineage are visible; no cookie, token or stored credential was read or copied

supplementalScreenshots.purpose: both disabled Not executable controls and the terminal change-safety and execution-capability evidence

requestAudit.intervalScope: the instrumented same-origin iframe, across one full page lifecycle at 1440x900 and 390x844
requestAudit.sanitization: URL CLASSES only: origin-relative pathnames, with every query string, header, cookie and token removed before recording. No credential, connection string or secret value is stored in this receipt.
requestAudit.statusZeroNote: one /api/meta/history/accounts entry reports status 0: a request the renderer superseded before a response was attributed. It is a GET either way; the retry that followed returned 200.
requestAudit.note: every observed request was a GET. No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE reached the application or any provider, and no DB, application or provider write was performed. The decisions-workspace read chain contains zero INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements.
requestAudit.productionTunnelWarning: the local .env.local DATABASE_URL resolves to 127.0.0.1:15432, an SSH tunnel to PRODUCTION. Only read-only GET paths were exercised.
